title: Form reducer with validation
summary: A sign-in form reducer that tracks values, touched fields and derived errors.
prompt: Write `formReducer(state, action)` and `errorsFor(values)` for a form with `email` and `password`. State is `{ values, touched, submitted }`. Actions: `change` (set a value), `blur` (mark a field touched), `submit` (set `submitted` and mark every field touched) and `reset` (back to `initialForm`). `errorsFor` derives errors, never stored in state: email must be non-empty after trimming (`'Required'`) and contain an `@` with text on both sides (`'Invalid email'`); password must be at least 8 characters (`'Too short'`, or `'Required'` when empty). Also write `visibleErrors(state)`, which returns only the errors for touched fields. Never mutate state. There is no React Native runtime here, so this is modelled as plain TypeScript.
hints: A regex like `/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+$/` checks text on both sides of `@`.
